Ed Maxwell Village of Jackson Center Zoning Enforcement Officer Zoning Ordinance 2004-19 Village of Jackson Center Office: (937) 596-6314 Cell: (937) 726-1504 If you need assistance with your application, office personnel or the Zoning Officer will assist you. In the event that an application is denied by the Zoning Enforcement Officer for cause, the applicant may appeal that decision to the Jackson Center Board of Zoning Appeals. An Application, "Notice of Appeal", is available at the Village Office. This appeal and a $50.00 Filing Fee must be submitted to the Fiscal Officer or Village Office within twenty (20) days of the decision, specifying the grounds upon which the appeal is taken.
